name: techne
description: AJ's personal Claude Code skill collection — repo-hygiene skills for audit, slop cleanup, doc-sync, CI review, commit planning, cross-repo drift detection, and document builds.

block_attribution_trailers.title: Block attribution lines in commits and PRs
block_attribution_trailers.description: Refuse git commit and gh pr create/edit/merge when the message or body carries a Claude-Session link, a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer, or a Generated with Claude Code line.

block_commits_md.title: Block staging COMMITS.md
block_commits_md.description: Refuse git add or git commit when it would stage or commit a COMMITS.md scratchpad.

warn_main_checkout_commit.title: Warn on commits in the main checkout
warn_main_checkout_commit.description: Warn when git commit runs in a repo's main checkout while linked worktrees exist.

restart_on_update.title: Restart idle sessions onto an updated Claude Code
restart_on_update.description: When Claude Code has updated on disk and this session is idle, open a new tmux window or Windows Terminal tab (WSL) that stops this session and resumes it on the new version. Any key during the 15 second countdown there cancels it.
